description: Use when working with embedded hardware on an authorized assessment or lab device you own. Covers finding UART consoles with a logic analyzer, getting a root shell over serial, identifying JTAG and SWD headers, and dumping memory with OpenOCD. Also use when a device boots but you have no software access and need a hardware debug path.
